title: Unit Event — Backlight, Lens Flare — Episode8 To Reach The Next Level

meta.Episode: Episode8 — To Reach The Next Level
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's next step is to appear as extras in a film! Each of them is enthusiastic about this opportunity to work their magic on camera, and Rui is particularly eager to learn about a different type of directing. However, not everything goes smoothly...

rows.Line: Airport

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Alright, Scene 143. And...

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Action!
se_event_lensflare_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Rui didn't come back after that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They told us that they'd made a small change for this scene, but how is what they've done gonna fix it?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I don't know, but for now...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (All we can do is believe in them.)

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “Then, Katsuyuki, that's all the more reason why I can't stay.”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “What...?”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line:
“H-How can you say that...?
You show up out of nowhere, mess with my feelings and...”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “The truth is, I don't care about what's really going on with you... I just...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He's expressing his character's feelings more than that first time...! But he still sounds really natural. He isn't having to do what he does on stage...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But this scene's feel...
It hasn't changed all that much. Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(The problem is somewhere up ahead.
When Hajime accepts what Katsuyuki says...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This is it!
We finally get to see what's different.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What happens when you erase Katsuyuki's lines?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My suggestion was to change Bakuno's lines to make them suit his style better.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But Mr. Ohara didn't want to do just that.
He decided to erase his lines for this part.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He originally said, “I'm guessing that's not even your real name,” “I still don't know anything about you,” and “Absolutely nothing...”)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In terms of the story, these lines are fairly crucial.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Without them, it becomes hard for the viewer to understand what's going through Katsuyuki's mind.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “I'm sorry.”
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “Hajime, wait!”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “*Sob*”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa... The look on Katsuyuki's face...! He's tugging at my heartstrings without saying a word...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's not just his expression.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: His breathing, the way he lowered his shoulders... The little things like that really make it clear just how sad Katsuyuki is, and how much he's struggling to control his feelings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is what Mr. Ohara meant by a “torrent of emotions”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This character...
Only Bakuno can play him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I never would've thought of making use of Bakuno's skills like this.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Mr. Ohara really is an incredible director...
I've only been working with him for a little bit, but that much is clear.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (As frustrated as I am about not coming up with this idea myself, I also feel a great sense of relief.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There really is nothing like directing.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There are so many facets to it. And I still have so much to learn.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I want to know more.
I want to encounter things that I haven't before...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, who was that person?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If it weren't for him, neither Mr. Ohara nor I would've been able to arrive at a solution.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should've at least asked his name...
A few weeks later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The film we got to help make turned out so well!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
To be fair, this is just the rough cut...
Still, getting to see it before it the advance screening makes joining the crew all the more worth it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A just reward considering everything we went through!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, I'm looking forward to seeing it in theaters.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I'm really glad I got to see it too♪
Thanks for letting me tag along, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. It probably means just as much to you, Rin, since you were there basically every day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Your encouragement was invaluable.
And I'm sorry for making you worry towards the end there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<No, that's okay!
I'm just glad that you're happy with the way things turned out, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I came to see what you guys were doing at first because I thought it'd be fun to make a film!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But seeing you all work so hard to make each scene as good as it could be...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That made me realize how hard it really is to make a film. It isn't just all fun and games.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But it turned out as well as it did because you guys put so much effort into it.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Which is why I think filmmaking is super duper amazing now!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We feel honored that our efforts led you to that conclusion.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe... I want Miku and the others to see this as soon as possible. When do you think they'll get to—>
se_walk_men_002_1
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, perfect. You're all here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bakuno? Mr. Ohara...?!

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Bakuno said he wanted to thank you himself for helping fix that scene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, me...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I didn't do anything worthy of being thanked. Ultimately, it was Mr. Ohara who came up with the solution.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: No, you and Mr. Ohara both made the decision to take a long, hard look at the screenplay.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, I wasn't sure what to do until you two brought forth your ideas. I was so worried that I'd be the one to ruin our film.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: But you both did your best to make the most of my abilities. As a result, that scene turned out better than I could've hoped.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
So, thank you very much.
What you did gave me a chance to reexamine myself as an actor and grow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Bakuno...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you as well.
I was also able to grow as a director.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You too, Mr. Ohara.
I can't thank you enough for giving me such a wonderful opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I really appreciate what you did for me.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: I asked you to help because you have such a good work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
So, don't be a stranger.
Feel free to drop by again whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I will.
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
I wanted to ask about that friend who suddenly came over to see you the other—

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line:
Excuse me, sir!
They're calling about that interview again!

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Oh, I completely forgot to call them back... Be right over!
se_run_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I missed my chance.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I suppose I'll have to try contacting him another time.)
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Phew...
That's it for filming...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Things always get so busy that I feel like I never want to shoot another film again, but that desire to create always crops back up.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Plus, this time around I got to meet an interesting—
Don't get all serious on me now.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
What the?!
How long have you been there?!

Hold up.
You're the one who said I should come since you had the rough cut ready.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Sure, but you're beyond late.
We already finished screening it.
Oh, that's too bad.

But I know you, Tomomi.
You're too nice to not show it again for a friend after he came all this way to see you.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
...
We have to leave soon.

Not a problem!
At least show me that one scene!

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: We already put everything away, so you'll have to watch it on my phone. No complaints.

I'm all good with that.
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “I'm sorry.”
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “Hajime, wait!”

Okay, this looks unchanged.
In that case, what did you—

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “*Sob*”
You took out his lines for this part?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Yeah, since I thought it'd suit his style better.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: As much as I hate to say it, what you said helped a lot.

So, what I said led you to do this?
Now I feel kind of bad.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Seriously, you always give me these weird riddles to solve and immediately leave.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Still, I'm amazed by how Kamishiro was able to unravel your little enigma and arrive at the answer he did.
Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
That kid I introduced you to the other day.
The one who was sitting next to me. He's well on his way towards becoming a famous director.

Oh...
I think I vaguely remember...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Geez...
You really can't remember anything unless it interests you, huh...?
No, I remember now.

So, this Kamishiro kid...
He got what I was trying to say?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
He did.
But he mainly works on stage productions.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
The same as you.
Which means you'll probably cross paths someday.
I see.
